description: Generate an invoice PDF from JSON. $0.02 USDC on Base per call. Computes line items, tax, discount and totals server-side; 12 currencies; multi-page. Validate free first at POST /v1/invoice/validate. Don't use this for sending the invoice; it only returns the PDF. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: paidpilot_invoice_pdf
title: PaidPilot Invoice API: POST /v1/invoice.pdf
